simpleJp: 5-1で力天使も倒して「破滅の降罪」を入手する
enGuide: Before defeating Grishina and ending 5-1, take the east-side Force Angel for the missable 100% reward. Approach with a character carrying 「守護の誓」, bait its Painkiller, activate the invulnerability barrier, survive 「テュラント」, then rush it down for 「破滅の降罪」.

simpleJp: BATTLE 5-1「消えない傷痕」でグリシナを倒す
BATTLE 5-2「嘆きの赤い牙」でレッド・ムフロンを倒す
enGuide: Defeat Red Mufflon. The enemy side acts first, so start from a defensive formation. General Japanese evidence confirms one repeat-talk item can be obtained in each free-action window; supplemental FFSKY specifically reports that speaking to the female Cipher Punk member twice after 5-2 yields 「巡礼する精霊」, but that exact NPC/item pairing is not promoted to a required step pending independent Japanese corroboration.
